name: Eversmoking Bottle

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Open
powers.text: Magic action: thick smoke pours out and fills 60 ft around the bottle (Heavily Obscured) until you stopper it.

powers.name: Stopper it
powers.text: Magic action: stopper the bottle; the smoke disperses.

summary: Opened, it pours out smoke that heavily obscures everything within 60 ft.
text: This 1-pound brass bottle, sealed with a lead stopper, constantly seeps smoke. Removing the stopper takes a Magic action and lets a dense cloud billow forth, filling a 60-foot Emanation centred on the bottle, and everything inside it is Heavily Obscured. For every minute the open bottle sits inside the cloud, the radius grows by 10 feet, to a maximum of 120 feet. The cloud lasts while the bottle stays open. Sealing it again means speaking its command word as a Magic action, after which the smoke disperses in 10 minutes. A moderate wind clears the smoke in 1 minute; a strong wind clears it in 1 round.
